summary: A cash-in-transit armoured truck: a lofted steel body with a short bonnet, a steeply raked armoured windscree… joints rear_door_l, rear_door_r, side_door, roof_hatch, wheel_f_l_roll, wheel_f_l_steer, …; options paint, band; sockets seat_driver, seat_crew_1, seat_crew_2, eye_point, socket_cargo, socket_rear_door, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.armored_truck or place "prefab": "armored_truck" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
